about.title: What is Addis Ababa City Tours
about.desc1: Addis Ababa City Tours is like having a friend's mom cook you a home cooked meal in every visit. We connect travelers with local, vetted hosts to share the joy of a homemade meal in their home and learn about their cultural and culinary traditions passed down through generations.
about.desc2: This experience is powered by Sphere Tour and Travel, a leading licensed tour operator based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Sphere Travel is dedicated to crafting sustainable, immersive, and culturally respectful journeys. Together, we open the doors of Ethiopian homes, offering a savory bridge to our rich heritage.
about.whatWeOfferSubtitle: To help you experience local cuisine while traveling, Addis Ababa City Tours offers in-home meals with our hosts. In addition, we also offer in-home cooking experiences as well as market visits as an add-on to many of the meal experiences. All of our hosts have been vetted to ensure a safe and delightful culinary experience.
about.offer1Desc: Savor a lovingly prepared feast inside a local host family's dining room, learning cultural dining etiquettes like Gursha.
about.offer2Desc: Get hands-on in the kitchen! Learn to bake spongy sourdough Injera and stir complex spicy wot stews from scratch.
about.offer3Desc: Accompany your host to colorful local spice and grain markets, selecting fresh ingredients and authentic Berbere blends.
about.bannerQuote: Experience the joy of a homemade meal (and eat it the way the locals do) over conversation about food and culture.
about.bannerAuthor: Authentic traditional Ethiopian dining with host families in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
about.startedDesc: Addis Ababa City Tours was founded in partnership with Sphere Tour and Travel to bring travelers closer to the real heartbeat of Ethiopia—its people, their stories, and their homes. Sphere Travel is renowned for sustainable tour design. Recognizing that culinary exchange is the ultimate form of cultural connection, we designed Addis Ababa City Tours to foster meaningful relationships and support local families by creating sustainable income opportunities for passionate home cooks.

founders.title: Our Visionary Founders
founders.subtitle: A partnership between passionate food enthusiasts and Sphere Tour & Travel's expert local guides.
founders.f1Desc: With over 15 years of experience showcasing Ethiopia's cultural richness, her vision is to preserve traditional family recipes and share the legendary warmth of Ethiopian hospitality with the world.
founders.f2Title: General Manager of Sphere Tour and Travel
founders.f2Desc: A sustainable tourism pioneer, he co-founded Addis Ababa City Tours to empower local families, bringing authentic and respectful tourism straight to the dining rooms of Addis Ababa.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Desc: Browse our curated, vetted experiences ranging from a simple traditional home-cooked meal to a deep culinary masterclass with market exploration.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Choose your preferred date, share any dietary requirements (vegan, gluten-free, halal), and submit your request through our secure platform.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Receive the host address and custom details. Sit at their family table, exchange stories, laugh, cook, and dine like a local.

safety.title: Your Safety & Our Vetting Standards
safety.subtitle: We prioritize safety, comfort, and top-tier hygiene to ensure your peace of mind.
safety.point1Desc: We visit every host family multiple times, checking hygiene, ingredient sourcing, cleanliness, and the friendliness of the atmosphere.
safety.point2Desc: Our hosts are fully trained in safe food preparation standards, maintaining clean water, and managing global dietary needs like severe allergies.
safety.point3Desc: Located in secure, highly accessible neighborhoods in Addis Ababa, with optional Sphere Travel transport arrangements available.

press.title: In the Press
press.quote: The next generation of culinary tourism. An unforgettable window into the beautiful culinary rituals of Addis Ababa.
press.featuredIn: Featured & trusted by leading global travel publications

careers.title: Join Our Hospitality Community
careers.subtitle: We are always looking for passionate hosts, local food experts, and cultural guides.
careers.c1Desc: Earn a sustainable income doing what you love—cooking and hosting! We provide training, safety support, and connect you with global food lovers.
careers.c2Desc: Help us discover amazing home cooks across Addis Ababa, translate, and lead tourists through colorful local markets.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q0: What is the relationship with Sphere Tour and Travel?
faq.a0: Addis Ababa City Tours is an exclusive culinary initiative powered and operated by Sphere Tour and Travel. As a fully licensed travel agency in Ethiopia, Sphere handles booking security, safe transportation, professional guides, and ensures our operations adhere to strict sustainable tourism guidelines.
faq.q1: Can my dietary requirements be accommodated?
faq.a1: Absolutely! Ethiopian cuisine is highly friendly to vegans (due to Orthodox Christian fasting traditions or 'Bayenetu') and gluten-free diets (using 100% pure Teff Injera). We collect your dietary preferences during booking and coordinate with your host family.
faq.a2: Yes, 100% of our experiences are completely private. It will be just you, your travel companions, and the host family. This allows for authentic, intimate conversations and high-quality interaction.
faq.q3: How do I reach the host's house?
faq.a3: Upon confirmation, we provide precise directions, host contact details, and landmarks. Additionally, as part of Sphere Tour and Travel, we can optionally arrange private round-trip hotel transfers with professional drivers.
